name: labs-OO-Agents
tagline: NVIDIA Object Oriented Agents: the Pythonic way to build AI agents
description: labs-OO-Agents is NVIDIA's Object Oriented Agents project: a Pythonic framework for building AI agents using object-oriented patterns. Instead of forcing agent logic into a single prompt or a rigid pipeline, the library lets you model agents, tools, and their interactions as objects — composable, testable, and reusable. It comes from the NVIDIA NeMo labs and targets developers who want structure and ergonomics in agent construction.
highlights: Object-oriented modeling for agents, tools, and interactions
Pythonic ergonomics from NVIDIA's NeMo labs
Composable and testable agent building blocks
curatorNote: Most agent frameworks treat code as an afterthought around a prompt. NVIDIA's OO approach treats agents as a software engineering problem — and that's the right instinct as agent systems get serious.
